svg.title: Clinical NLP — recommendation system architecture
svg.desc: Implemented preparation: four protocols, extraction and visual review, 32 canonical cards and BM25 indexing. Patient facts and indexed evidence feed retrieval, Qwen model, shared applicability and missing-information checks, and four-category care plan with citations. Baseline takes the direct path; Improved alone adds the tested pre-model applicability preview. Patient context and source IDs remain attached. Zero cards causes no model call. Future dashed connections show NER with clinician confirmation, doctor acceptance, prescription draft and governed feedback to reviewed cards.
svg.text: Patient context + source IDs stay attached throughout the pipeline
Solid arrows: implemented flow Dashed arrows: future design only No NER or prescription integration is implemented.
